name: Charli Paci Pizzeria & Pantry
address: 11 Malva Rd, Dana Bay, Mossel Bay, 6500, South Africa
description_short: Authentic wood-fired pizzas and Italian pantry favourites in the relaxed coastal suburb of Dana Bay.
description_long:
Charli Paci brings a slice of Italy to Dana Bay with their wood-fired pizzeria and pantry concept. The restaurant's warm, inviting atmosphere makes it a favourite among locals and visitors looking for honest Italian cooking without the fuss.

The pizzas are the star here – thin, crispy bases topped with quality ingredients and baked to perfection in their wood-fired oven. Beyond the pizzas, the pantry selection offers Italian deli items, fresh salads, and homemade pasta dishes that showcase simple, flavourful cooking. It's the kind of neighbourhood spot where families gather for Tuesday night dinner and friends meet for a casual weekend lunch.

Located in the residential Dana Bay area just outside Mossel Bay's main centre, Charli Paci has built a loyal following with consistent quality and friendly service. The relaxed vibe and mid-range pricing make it an easy choice when you're craving something more interesting than the usual chain offerings.
